flash.created: Product created. It is still hidden.
flash.shown: The product is now visible in the shop.
flash.deleted: Product deleted. You can restore it for 30 days.
flash.restored: Restored. The product is still hidden.
flash.banner_created: Banner created. It is not active yet.
flash.banner_activated: The banner now shows at the top of the shop.

notices.flag_off: The shop is switched off in the app (flag “shop”). Members only see the note that it is moving in.
notices.store_missing: No shop address is set on the server yet; the operator adds it in the hosting settings. Products bought in the online shop show “Coming soon to the shop”, and a product address cannot be saved yet.

products.title: Shop products
products.intro: What the app's Shop tab lists, in this order. Payment happens in the online shop, never in the app.
products.caption: Shop products in shop order
products.empty_title: No products in the shop yet
products.empty_body: Create the first product. It stays hidden until it has a photo and a way to buy.

delete.title: Delete “:title”?
delete.body: The product leaves the shop at once, and a banner pointing to it shows nothing. You can restore it for 30 days; after that the product and its photos are gone for good. We ask for your password once more.

reorder.title: Order in the shop
reorder.intro: Drag the products into place, or pick one up with Space and move it with the arrow keys. Hidden products keep their place.
reorder.help: Drag, or focus the handle, Space, arrow keys, Space. Escape cancels.
reorder.grabbed: “:name” picked up. Move it with the arrow keys, drop it with Space.
reorder.needs_unfiltered: Change the order in the unfiltered list, sorted by position.
reorder.too_many: More than 100 products: the order can no longer be changed here on one page.
reorder.discard_body: You reordered the products but did not save.

form.load_error: The product is not loading right now
form.title: Title
form.title_hint: As in the online shop, e.g. “Car-Sticker – dein Design”.
form.title_required: Enter a title of at least 2 characters.
form.slug_hint: Part of the product address in the app: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens only.
form.slug_hint_new: Leave it empty and we build it from the title. Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens only.
form.description_hint: Plain text, paragraphs separated by a blank line. Material, size, care.
form.price_intro: Enter the price as the online shop shows it, as the final price including VAT. The price at the shop's checkout is binding.
form.price_invalid: Enter the price in euros, e.g. 14.90.
form.buy_intro: Where the app's buy button leads. Payment never happens in the app.

mode_hint.shopify: The button opens the product page in the online shop.
mode_hint.sticker_designer: The button opens the sticker designer. The order follows in the online shop, with the design.

form.url_hint: https://…/products/… on :hosts. The server accepts no other address.
form.url_store_missing: Only once the operator has set the shop address in the hosting settings.
form.url_empty: Without a product address the app shows “Coming soon to the shop”, and the product cannot be shown.
form.trashed_body: Gone for good on :date. Restoring brings the product back hidden; until then it cannot be edited.
form.discard_body: What you changed since the last save will be lost.

variants.title: Variants
variants.intro: One row of choice chips on the product page. With a Shopify variant ID the purchase lands right on that variant in the shop's cart.
variants.label: Variant :n
variants.none: No variants: the product page shows no choice.

images.title: Photos
images.intro: The first photo is the shop tile. We crop every photo to 4:5 around its focal point; the original stays private, so a new focal point needs no new upload.
images.order_failed: The photo order was not saved
images.empty: No photo yet. Without a photo the product cannot be shown.
images.drop: Drag a photo here or choose one
images.full: The photo limit is reached. Remove one to upload a new one.
images.rules: JPEG, PNG or WebP, at least :width × :height px, up to :size MB, at most :max photos
images.too_large: The file is larger than :size MB.
images.too_small: The photo is :actual_width × :actual_height px. The 4:5 crop needs at least :width × :height px.
images.after_create: You upload photos once the product is created.
images.edit_description: Focal point of the 4:5 crop and the image description.
images.focal_value: :x % from the left, :y % from the top
images.focal_hint: Click into the image or use the arrow keys (with Shift in bigger steps).
images.already_45: The photo is already 4:5, the crop is the whole photo.
images.crop_pending: The new crop is computed from the original when you save.
images.alt_hint: What the photo shows, for screen readers. No advertising copy.
images.remove_body: The photo and all its sizes are deleted. This cannot be undone.
images.remove_last_visible: This is the last photo of a visible product. Hide the product first, then you can remove it.

visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.intro: A new product starts hidden. It can be shown once it has a photo and a way to buy.
visibility.missing_list: Still missing before it can be shown: :items.

missing.shopify_url: the product address in the shop

visibility.save_first: Save your changes first, then you can switch the visibility.

preview.title: Preview
preview.frame: How the product looks in the app
preview.saved_state: The saved state, exactly as the app receives it.
preview.unsaved: Unsaved changes appear here after saving.
preview.needs_photo: The preview appears with the first photo.
preview.unavailable: The preview is not loading right now. Reload the page.
preview.external_note: You switch to the online shop :host. Payment happens there, never in the app.
preview.external_note_no_host: You switch to the online shop. Payment happens there, never in the app.
preview.designer_note: You design the sticker for your car in the app. The order follows in the online shop.

banners.title: Shop banners
banners.intro: The large image at the top of the app's Shop tab. At most one banner is active; it leads to a product or a category.
banners.load_error: The banners are not loading right now
banners.empty_body: Without a banner the shop starts right with the products. A night photo with a short title makes the opening.
banners.summary_active: At the top of the shop in the app: “:title”.
banners.summary_blocked: “:title” is active but not shown: the linked product is not in the shop.
banners.summary_none: No banner active: the shop starts with the products.
banners.problem_hidden: The product is hidden, so the banner is not shown.
banners.problem_gone: The product no longer exists. Choose another target.
banners.activate_body: The banner appears at the top of the Shop tab.
banners.activate_replaces: The banner appears at the top of the Shop tab; “:title” is switched off for it.
banners.deactivate_body: The shop then starts right with the products.
banners.delete_body: The banner and its photo are deleted for good. We ask for your password once more.
banners.drawer_description: Photo, title and target of the large image at the top of the shop.
banners.focal_hint: The app crops the photo to 16:9 around this point. Click into the image or use the arrow keys.
banners.rules: JPEG, PNG or WebP, at least :width px wide, a format between 4:5 and 21:9, up to :size MB
banners.file_required: Choose a photo for the banner.
banners.too_narrow: The photo is :actual px wide; a banner needs at least :width px.
banners.ratio: The format does not fit: anything between 4:5 (tall) and 21:9 (wide) works.
banners.title_required: Enter a title of at least 2 characters.
banners.subtitle: Subtitle

link.title: Target
link.category_hint: The shop filters to this category.
link.no_products: No products yet. Create one first.
link.hidden_warning: The product is hidden: until it is shown, the app does not show the banner.

banners.product_required: Choose a product for the banner to point to.
banners.starts_inactive: A new banner starts switched off.
